General compiler behaviour found here: a keyframe_review entry without from/to takes its shapes.csv years, and a 'wrong' verdict with a correction is still drawn as that correction. Prose like 'holds 451-461 only' is not parsed, so overlapping keyframes are unioned. Four such cases were fixed in this batch (white-huns_410, gupta-empire_451, rouran-khaganate_480, rouran-khaganate_534); other dossiers may have more.
